parameters.query:
INSERT INTO athkar_users (telegram_id, first_name, username, is_active)
VALUES ($1::bigint, $2, $3, true)
ON CONFLICT (telegram_id) DO UPDATE SET is_active = true, first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name, username = EXCLUDED.username, updated_at = now()
RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS is_new, morning_time, evening_time;

SELECT id, code, title_ar, count(*) OVER() AS total
FROM athkar_categories ORDER BY sort_order LIMIT 10 OFFSET ($1::int * 10);

SELECT c.code AS cat_code, c.title_ar, i.code AS item_code, i.position, i.text_ar, i.repeat_count
FROM athkar_items i JOIN athkar_categories c ON c.id = i.category_id
WHERE c.code = upper($1) OR i.code = upper($1)
ORDER BY c.sort_order, i.position;
SELECT is_active, morning_time, evening_time FROM athkar_users WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint;

UPDATE athkar_users SET
  morning_time = CASE WHEN $2 = 'morning' THEN $3::time ELSE morning_time END,
  evening_time = CASE WHEN $2 = 'evening' THEN $3::time ELSE evening_time END,
  updated_at = now()
WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint
RETURNING is_active, morning_time, evening_time;

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.telegram_id, s.slot, c.id AS category_id
FROM athkar_users u
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('morning', u.morning_time), ('evening', u.evening_time)) AS s(slot, t)
JOIN athkar_categories c ON c.slug = 'morning_evening'
WHERE u.is_active
  AND (now() AT TIME ZONE u.timezone)::time >= s.t
  AND (now() AT TIME ZONE u.timezone)::time < s.t + interval '2 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM athkar_send_log l
    WHERE l.user_id = u.id AND l.category_id = c.id AND l.slot = s.slot
      AND l.sent_on = (now() AT TIME ZONE u.timezone)::date
  );

INSERT INTO athkar_send_log (user_id, category_id, slot, sent_on)
SELECT id, $2::int, $3, (now() AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date
FROM athkar_users WHERE id = $1::uuid AND $4::boolean
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
